LESSON: SELECTED CROP MANAGEMENT PRACTISES

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: Food Production Processes
Topic 2.2: Selected Crop Management Practises

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Selected Crop Management Practises. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How can we carry out management practises in crop production?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain management practises carried out on crops

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: SELECTED CROP MANAGEMENT PRACTISES
This lesson teaches Selected Crop Management Practises for Grade 7 AGRICULTURE.

STUDY STEPS
1. explain management practises carried out on crops
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Selected Crop Management Practises using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Selected Crop Management Practises above.
2. Explain Selected Crop Management Practises to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Selected Crop Management Practises.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Selected Crop Management Practises with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Selected Crop Management Practises important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can we carry out management practises in crop production?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. explain management practises carried out on crops

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
